concerns.text: The plan uses a single 80/20 train/validation split on a modest dataset (≥ 500 records). This provides a noisy estimate of model performance and may lead to over‑ or under‑estimation of predictive ability. A more robust approach (e.g., repeated k‑fold cross‑validation or bootstrap resampling) should be adopted to obtain stable performance metrics and confidence intervals.

Molecular size (e.g., atom count or total vdW volume) is a known determinant of the packing coefficient, yet the primary SMILES‑only model explicitly excludes atom‑count features and does not adjust the target for size (CAPE is only a diagnostic). Without explicitly controlling for size as a covariate, the relationship between SMILES topology and PC_raw may be confounded, threatening construct validity. Include atom‑count or a size‑adjusted target in the regression (or model it as a covariate) rather than relying solely on post‑hoc residual analysis.
